issues.issue: Group E PR is stated as 33% with CR 6% and ORR 38% but 6%+33%=39% not 38%; minor arithmetic aside, the values are cited, but Group E CR/PR (6%, 33%) come from line 248 which is verified—no issue there; however Group D 'PR 69%' plus 'CR 2.9%' does not sum to ORR 71% (should be ~71.9%), a rounding artifact from source, acceptable.
Automated flag 'uncited number 01' is a false positive: it is a fragment of the trial identifier SOHO-01/Project ORBIS, not an efficacy/safety figure.
The 'First-in-human trial' claim is not supported by the citation quote, which only describes the trial as non-randomized single-arm and does not state it is first-in-human.
The text says tumor samples 'were retrospectively tested using Oncomine Dx Target Test' but the citation states only 67.2% (82/122) were so tested, so 'tumor samples' overgeneralizes the cited quote.
